referral.agreementIntro: By joining the "Refer & Earn" Program, you agree to the following terms:
referral.term1Content: You will receive $ 30.00 (thirty dollars) for each referred neighbor who is approved as a TooDroper (receiving point) on the platform.
referral.term2Content: The commission will be credited to your balance only after the complete approval of the referred person as a hub by the Toodrop team, including document and address validation.
referral.term3Content: The referral will be valid for 90 (ninety) days from the date the invite was sent. After this period, if the referred person has not completed registration, the referral will expire.
referral.term4Rule1: Each person can only be referred once
referral.term4Rule3: TooDrop reserves the right to cancel fraudulent referrals
referral.term4Rule4: Values and terms may be changed with prior notice
referral.term5Content: The commission value can be withdrawn along with your other earnings on the platform, respecting the minimum withdrawal amount of $ 20.00.

step1.title: How does Toodrop work for you as a consumer?
step1.description: Toodrop connects you to nearby delivery points, authorized by you. If you're not home, your package goes to a safe location — it could even be your neighbor. No more waiting around for deliveries: pick up whenever you want. Here, you are the Dropper One.

step2.title: First step: Register an address
step2.description: To get started, you need to register at least one delivery address. We'll use it to find the nearest pickup points in your neighborhood.

step3.title: Finally, create a DropTag
step3.description: A DropTag is your virtual delivery label. For each purchase you make, create a DropTag. This allows us to match your delivery data with the driver's information and ensure your package reaches your authorized receiving neighbor!
